name: MinnowZ 3"
notes: ElaZtech material — nearly indestructible. Fish on 1/8–1/4 oz jighead. Top inshore producer.

name: MinnowZ 4"
notes: Larger profile for bigger trout and red drum. Buoyant ElaZtech rides hook-up on a jighead.

name: SwimmerZ 5"
notes: Big-fish paddle-tail. Match mullet or shad and slow-roll near structure.

name: StreakZ 4"
notes: Jerkbait/stick bait style. Twitch-and-pause for speckled trout in clear water.

name: TRD (The Real Deal) 2.75"
notes: Finesse bait for pressured fish. Best on a 1/16–1/8 oz jighead; very effective for flounder and trout.

name: ShrimpZ 2.5"
notes: Realistic ElaZtech shrimp that outlasts ordinary soft plastics. Weedless on a light jighead; superb for redfish on shallow flats.

name: Diezel MinnowZ 4"
notes: Wide-wobble paddle tail with thick body. Great for slower retrieves in cooler water.

name: CrabZ 2.5"
notes: ElaZtech crab imitation — nearly indestructible. Sheepshead and redfish tear these up around structure and oyster bars.

name: Finesse ShrimpZ 3"
notes: Slightly larger shrimp profile with added legs for more water displacement. Deadly on a drop-shot or light jighead.

name: Gulp! Shrimp 3"
notes: Scented attractant outfishes plain plastic in dirty water. Fish under a cork or on a jighead.

name: Gulp! Shrimp 4"
notes: Larger scent-loaded shrimp for bigger fish. Heavy Gulp attractant makes it effective in stained water.

name: Gulp! Sand Crab 2"
notes: Best soft plastic for surf perch and corbina. Drag slowly along sandy bottom in the swash zone.

name: Gulp! Crab 2"
notes: Crab imitation with potent Gulp scent. Excellent for sheepshead, permit, and tautog near structure.

name: Gulp! Nemesis 4"
notes: Scent-loaded paddle-tail. Great for flounder on a drag-and-lift retrieve near structure.

name: Gulp! Swimming Mullet 3"
notes: Paddle-tail mullet with heavy Gulp scent. Works great under a popping cork for speckled trout and redfish.

name: Gulp! Swimming Mullet 4"
notes: Larger scent-loaded paddle tail for redfish and trophy trout. Match the hatch during fall mullet runs.

name: Gulp! Jerk Shad 4"
notes: Shad-profile jerkbait with heavy Gulp attractant. Twitch on a light jighead for flounder and speckled trout.

name: Gulp! Sandworm 6"
notes: Worm imitation with heavy attractant. Rig on a dropper loop or Carolina rig for surf perch, spot, and flounder from the surf.

name: Gulp! Fry 1"
notes: Tiny scent-loaded baitfish imitation. Deadly for panfish, spot, and croaker on ultralight tackle from piers.

name: Gulp! Saltwater Grub 3"
notes: Curly tail with heavy Gulp scent. Versatile jig trailer or standalone on a 1/8 oz head in the surf.

name: Gulp! Mantis Shrimp 3"
notes: Realistic mantis shrimp profile with Gulp attractant. Particularly effective for permit and pompano on sandy flats.

name: Terror Eyz 3"
notes: Big eyes and paddle tail. Excellent for speckled trout at night under lights.

name: D.O.A. Shrimp 3"
notes: Incredibly realistic shrimp imitation. Can be fished free-lined, under a cork, or on a jighead.

name: Baitbuster 7"
notes: Large swimbait for snook, tarpon, and big reds. Fish near structure on an incoming tide.

name: Sea Shad 4"
notes: Texas staple for speckled trout and redfish. Lively paddle tail on a 1/4 oz jighead.

name: Die Dapper 3"
notes: Shrimp-tail action bait. Twitched under a popping cork, it's irresistible to speckled trout and redfish.

name: Saltwater Shad 5"
notes: Big paddle tail for trophy trout and big redfish. Slow-roll on a 3/4 oz jighead near structure.

name: Super Fluke 5"
notes: Soft jerkbait — twitch and pause for big flounder and striped bass. Can be weedless-rigged.

name: Swing Impact 3.8"
notes: Japanese finesse paddle-tail. Incredibly lifelike action; excellent for flounder and trout.

name: Original Paddle Tail 6"
notes: Northeast staple for striped bass and bluefish. Slow-roll along the bottom or through baitfish schools.

name: Sand Eel 6"
notes: Realistic sand eel profile. Deadly for striped bass and weakfish in the Northeast.

name: Vudu Shrimp 3.5"
notes: Lifelike shrimp with LED insert option. Self-weedless; works well around oyster bars.

name: Kalin's Grub 3"
notes: Curly tail grub for all-around jigging. Great for flounder and weakfish on a 1/4 oz jighead.

name: WildEye Swim Shad 3"
notes: Pre-rigged paddle-tail with a realistic eye and lifelike finish. Ready to fish out of the pack.

name: Ultrahead Swimbait Hook
notes: Weighted swimbait hook for rigging paddle-tails weedless. Perfect for heavy grass and structure.

name: EZ Shrimp Strip
notes: Scent-loaded attractant strips that mimic shrimp. Cut to length and tip a jig or hook for extra attraction in the surf.

name: Lil' John
notes: Paddle tail with internal rattle and bold eyes. Extra flash and noise for trout in dingy or stained water.

name: Hopkins Shorty 1 oz
notes: Classic surf and pier metal. Cast as far as possible, burn back through the water column.

name: Hopkins Shorty 3/4 oz
notes: Lighter version of the classic shorty. Better for lighter tackle and calm surf conditions.

name: No=Eql 1.5 oz
notes: Larger profile for bigger fish. Best in breaking water with birds working.

name: Kastmaster 1 oz
notes: Compact aerodynamic jig that casts a mile. Deadly on false albacore and Spanish mackerel.

name: Phoebe 3/8 oz
notes: Ultra-thin blade jig with intense fluttering action. Excellent for false albacore and bonito on light tackle.

name: Deadly Dick 1.5 oz
notes: Rhode Island classic for false albacore and bonito. Fast fluttering action on the fall.

name: Eel Jig 2 oz
notes: Slim eel profile drops fast to depth. Great for striped bass around structure when fish are holding deep.

name: AVA 007
notes: Lightweight albie/bonito jig. Cast into busting fish and burn as fast as you can.

name: AVA A17
notes: All-around Northeast metal. Surf, pier, and boat; great for bass and blues from the rocks.

name: Butterfly Flat-Fall 150g
notes: Slow-pitch/flat-fall jig for deeper structure. Flutter action on the fall triggers reaction strikes.

name: Silver Minnow 3/4 oz
notes: Weedless spoon for grass flats and marsh. Slow roll through vegetation for redfish.

name: Pet Spoon #7
notes: Classic flutter spoon for Spanish mackerel and bluefish. Add a tuft of hair for extra attraction.

name: Flasher Spoon 1 oz
notes: Hammered finish for maximum flash. Trolled or cast; great for Spanish mackerel.

name: Clarkspoon #1
notes: Classic king and Spanish mackerel spoon. Run behind a planer at 5–8 knots.

name: Clarkspoon #2
notes: Larger version for king mackerel. Use stinger hook for short-striking fish.

name: Drone Spoon #1
notes: Classic deep-running trolling spoon. Troll with downrigger or heavy planer for kings.

name: Krocodile Spoon 1 oz
notes: West Coast classic. Deadly for Pacific bonito and yellowtail; cast and burn or troll.

name: Fatso Spoon 1/2 oz
notes: Compact fluttering spoon. Cast to breaking schools of Spanish mackerel; works well off piers.

name: Zara Spook
notes: The original walk-the-dog. Dawn and dusk around grass flats and sand bars.

name: Super Spook Jr.
notes: Downsized Spook for speckled trout and smaller reds. Walk-the-dog on light tackle.

name: One Knocker Spook
notes: Single ball-bearing rattle for extra noise. Good in murky water or at night.

name: Chug'n Spook Jr.
notes: Cup-face popper for bluefish and striped bass from piers and jetties. Pop aggressively around bait schools.

name: Top Dog
notes: Trout tournament staple along Gulf and South Atlantic. Walk fast in calm, slow in chop.

name: Top Dog Jr.
notes: Smaller profile for finicky fish. Great for trout in skinny water.

name: Top Pup
notes: Hard chugger popper for speckled trout and snook in the surf. Walk-and-pop retrieve along grass edges.

name: Skitter Walk 11
notes: Loud topwater with rattle. Works well in choppy water when fish need help finding it.

name: SubWalk 11
notes: Sub-surface walker that creates a V-wake just under the surface. Effective when fish are shallow but won't commit to a topwater.

name: Sexy Dawg Jr.
notes: Easy walk-the-dog action with less rod work. Great for beginners learning topwater fishing.

name: 52M Series
notes: Classic suspending twitchbait for speckled trout. Twitch-twitch-pause in cold water.

name: MR17 Series
notes: Shallow-running hardbait for speckled trout and redfish. Works well around dock lights.

name: Catch 2000
notes: Slow-sink twitchbait that rivals the 52M in clear Gulf water. Superb in cold winter conditions for trophy trout.

name: X-Rap 10
notes: Aggressive slash-bait action. Deadly for striped bass and bluefish along jetties.

name: X-Rap Saltwater 12
notes: Saltwater-specific X-Rap with heavy-duty hooks and split rings. Cast along jetties for snook, stripers, and blues.

name: Countdown 11
notes: Sinking minnow — count down to depth, then retrieve at any speed. Classics never die.

name: Crystal Minnow 3D
notes: 3D holographic finish for maximum flash. Trolling or casting for coastal pelagics.

name: Mag Minnow 4"
notes: Sinking minnow with magnetic weight transfer for ultra-long casts. Great for surf stripers and snook.

name: 3D Inshore Twitch Bait
notes: Suspending twitchbait for speckled trout and flounder. Twitch-pause in grass flat pockets.

name: Got-Cha Plug 7/8 oz
notes: Classic pier lure for Spanish mackerel, bluefish, and jack. Cast and burn fast through surface schools — a must-have for any pier bag.

name: Fat Boy Corky
notes: Gulf Coast legend for speckled trout. Slow sink with a walk-the-dog twitch; deadly in cold winter water.

name: Devil Corky
notes: Floating Corky with loud rattle. Walk-the-dog near grass beds at dawn for big speckled trout on the Gulf.

name: Long A 4.5"
notes: Slow sinking minnow. Trolled on the surface for striped bass; also cast to breaking fish.

name: Saltwater Grade A
notes: Deep-diving crankbait for structure. Trolled around piers and bridges for speckled trout.

name: X-Rap Magnum 15
notes: High-speed trolling plug for wahoo and mahi. Runs true at 12–18 knots without a planer.

name: Iland Lure Large
notes: Used as a teaser-bait or rigged with a ballyhoo. Covers all billfish and large pelagics.

name: Sea Witch 6"
notes: Rigged in front of a ballyhoo or strip bait. Standard offshore spread lure for all pelagics.

name: Speed Pro 130
notes: High-speed trolling lure for wahoo and tuna. Add a stinger hook for clean hookups.

name: Prime Bucktail 1 oz
notes: Premium hand-tied bucktail. Add a soft plastic trailer and bounce on bottom for flounder.

name: Prime Bucktail 2 oz
notes: Heavier model for deeper water and stronger current. Essential pier and inlet striper jig.

name: Bucktail Jig 1 oz
notes: Hand-tied with premium hair and a strong hook. Bounce along sandy bottoms for flounder and weakfish.

name: Epoxy Jig 1.5 oz
notes: Durable epoxy head with bucktail skirt. Slower sink rate keeps it in the strike zone longer.

name: Silly Willy 3/8 oz
notes: The gold standard pompano jig. Bounce on sandy bottom through the trough in the surf.

name: Pompano Jig 3/8 oz
notes: Scented body with bright colors. Pompano can't resist this in the wash.

name: Gulp! Pompano Jig
notes: Combines scent of Gulp with a pompano-style head. Extremely effective in off-color water.

name: Skitter Pop 9
notes: Propeller-tailed popper for extra disturbance. Works well in chop where a walk-the-dog won't produce.

name: Popping Pencil 132
notes: Combination walker/popper for jack crevalle and large surf species. Pop-and-walk retrieve.

name: Talkin' Popper 4.5"
notes: Loud cup-face popper for bluefish and striped bass. Pop hard when fish are busting bait.

name: Holographic Swim Shad 5"
notes: Pre-rigged paddle tail with holographic finish and weighted jighead. Northeast pier staple for striped bass.

name: Crippled Herring 3 oz
notes: West Coast iron jig for yellowtail and white seabass. Flyline on a semi-slack line; let it flutter on the drop.

name: Tady 45
notes: SoCal open-party boat staple. Counted down to depth or free-lined in the kelp.

name: 6X Jr.
notes: California iron jig for yellowtail and bonito. Fast retrieve near the surface when fish are busting.

name: Shad Dart 1/8 oz
notes: Spring river staple for American and hickory shad. Fish tandem rigs in current seams.

name: Shad Dart 1/16 oz
notes: Ultralight shad dart for clear rivers and finicky fish. Drift on a 4 lb mono leader.

name: Pencil Popper 1 oz
notes: Northeast surf icon for striped bass and bluefish. Walk-the-dog retrieve creates explosive surface strikes in the wash.

name: Red Fin 4.5"
notes: Slow-sinking swimmer beloved by striper surf casters. Twitch and pause through rips and inlets — a surf plug hall-of-famer.

name: Pencil Popper 2 oz
notes: New England surf legend. Walk-the-dog in heavy wash at night for striped bass — proven on fish over 40 lbs.

name: Polaris Darter
notes: Classic New England surface swimmer with pivoting tail. Works in heavy surf where a standard popper rolls out.

name: Sand Eel 2 oz
notes: Pencil-shaped hard bait imitating a sand eel. Slow retrieve through rips and runnels for trophy stripers.

name: Little Neck Popper 1.5 oz
notes: Connecticut surf classic for striped bass at dawn. Loud cup-face creates a big splash trail in a breaking surf.

name: Zig-Zag 1 oz
notes: Cigar-style walk-the-dog plug with erratic action. Fish at night in the suds alongside poppers.

name: DTX Minnow 110
notes: Trolling and casting hard bait with exceptional build quality. Works inshore and offshore on species from snook to tuna.

name: DTX Minnow 165
notes: Larger DTX for trolling offshore species. Stainless-grade hardware handles wahoo, tuna, and mahi without deforming.

name: Madscad 150
notes: Large S-curve swimbait with lifelike action at any speed. Target big amberjack, cobia, and snook near deep structure.

name: Realis Jerkbait 120SP
notes: Japanese-engineered suspending jerkbait. Neutrally buoyant on the pause — exceptional for sea trout and snook in clear water.

name: Coltsniper Jig 60g
notes: High-density metal jig with an erratic flutter on the fall. Excellent for amberjack and cobia from piers and jetties.

name: Coltsniper Xtune 140F
notes: Long-cast pencil topwater with Shimano's weight-transfer system. Walk-the-dog from jetties for stripers and big bluefish.

name: Mullet Swimstick 5"
notes: Hyper-realistic mullet imitation with internal 3D detail. Deadly during fall mullet runs for snook, redfish, and tarpon.

name: Hollow Body Shrimp 2.5"
notes: Weedless hollow-body shrimp with striking lifelike detail. Rig on a wide-gap hook around grass beds and mangrove edges.

name: 3DB Jerkbait 120
notes: Suspending jerkbait with 3D holographic body. Twitch-pause for striped bass, snook, and speckled trout.

name: Bonita 6"
notes: Trolling lure for wahoo, mahi, and tuna. Bullet-shaped head pushes water for strong action at high speed.

name: Kickin' Minnow 4"
notes: Suspending twitchbait with a pronounced kick. Great from piers for flounder, pompano, and speckled trout.

name: 3D Shrimp 3.5"
notes: Scan-to-lure realistic shrimp. Free-lined or on a light jighead for snook, speckled trout, and redfish.

name: 3D Minnow 4"
notes: Scan-derived realism in a compact suspending minnow. Works for speckled trout, weakfish, and flounder.

name: Twisty 20g
notes: Spinning blade metal from Australia that casts extremely far on light tackle. Great for bluefish, bonito, and trevally.

name: Gulp! Alive Shrimp 3"
notes: Pre-soaked in Gulp! Alive attractant for maximum scent dispersion. Dead-stick under a cork or slow-drag for finicky fish.

name: Gulp! White Shrimp 2.5"
notes: Small-profile shrimp for finicky fish. Excellent under a popping cork for speckled trout in clear, calm conditions.

name: MinnowZ 5"
notes: Oversized ElaZtech paddle tail for big fish. Slow-roll on a 3/4 oz head for trophy snook, redfish, and flounder.

name: Scented Jerk ShadZ 5"
notes: Large ElaZtech shad with built-in scent. Target big snook, striped bass, and amberjack near deep structure.

name: Rattlin' Flash-A 3/4 oz
notes: Noisy diving crankbait with loud internal rattle. Cranked along bottom structure for flounder and striped bass.

name: Bucktail Jig 3/4 oz
notes: Classic all-purpose bucktail. Tip with a strip bait or soft plastic trailer for flounder from bridges and piers.

name: Gotcha Jig 3/8 oz
notes: Proven pompano jig for the Southeast surf. Bounce along the bottom in the trough between sandbars.

name: Pro Pompano Jig 3/8 oz
notes: Scented body and vivid skirt colors. Double-rig tandem style for multiple pompano hookups in the surf.

name: Butterfly Flat-Fall 200g
notes: Heavier flat-fall jig for deep amberjack and snapper. Slow-pitch technique keeps the flutter in the strike zone.

name: Tady C-45
notes: Smaller Tady for lighter tackle. Bonito, barracuda, and yellowtail on 20–30 lb gear off the kelp.

name: Super Bird 12"
notes: Daisy-chain teaser or rigged bait for billfish. Massive bubble trail draws fish from a long distance in the wake.

name: Hydro Popper 150
notes: Large offshore surface popper for mahi, tuna, and GT. Cast to surface-feeding fish or slow-troll around structure.
